dimensions.label: 数据隐私
dimensions.note: Public learning or elder-service scenarios could drift into personal or sensitive data.
dimensions.mitigation: Synthetic-only tabletop; minimum-data gate; no personal, biometric, minor or live data.
dimensions.human_review: A qualified data/IP reviewer must approve any future data change.

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度
dimensions.note: Cross-rail, campus and public-space interfaces need several disciplines and permissions.
dimensions.mitigation: Use reversible pilots and stop at the interface when survey, fire, structure or rights evidence is missing.
dimensions.human_review: Planning, architecture, transport, fire and accessibility professionals review before site work.

dimensions.label: 公众接受度
dimensions.note: Residents may read the project as technology display or surveillance.
dimensions.mitigation: Publish purpose, data, owner, status, non-AI route, appeal and retirement receipt at each scenario.
dimensions.human_review: Community representatives and public observers join quarterly reviews.

dimensions.label: 运维成本
dimensions.note: Staffed fallback, maintenance and evidence publishing can be underfunded.
dimensions.mitigation: No opening without an owner, maintenance window, replacement plan and relative cost band.
dimensions.human_review: Sponsor and site operator sign the service/retirement decision.

dimensions.label: 政策不确定性
dimensions.note: Official geometry, controls and implementation mandate remain incomplete.
dimensions.mitigation: Keep statutory values unknown and trigger full regeneration when official evidence arrives.
dimensions.human_review: Government and professional review is required for any formal use.

dimensions.label: 空间争议
dimensions.note: Concept interfaces may overlap rights, rail safety or protected urban fabric.
dimensions.mitigation: No parcel or demolition claim; test only on an opted-in provisional interface.
dimensions.human_review: Rights holders, rail/safety authorities and heritage professionals decide access.

dimensions.label: 技术成熟度
dimensions.note: AI outputs may be wrong, unstable or hard to explain.
dimensions.mitigation: AI never decides high-impact matters; use sources, human review and physical off control.
dimensions.human_review: Independent evaluator and responsible service owner accept or retire each use.

dimensions.label: 公平与包容性
dimensions.note: Digital-first service may exclude older, disabled or low-connectivity users.
dimensions.mitigation: Fund an equivalent staffed paper/in-person route and co-review continuous accessibility.
dimensions.human_review: Disabled and older users or representative organizations must join usability review.
